label: Every respect tested by universal esse transfer is esse or has an actual covered realization
paraphrase: Open scope condition on the same actuality and efficient-responsibility dictionary as the target. For each universal esse source and each distinct recipient whose esse it causes, an actual respect either is esse or has an occurring token at that bearer and respect in the named source's covered family. The family is a supplied classification. This premise claims neither source ancestry nor causation in each respect. Limiting the evidence to acquired qualities leaves other real respects uncovered.
